lines.prompt: Decompose all XOR gates in the fanin cone of n2281 into AND, OR, and NOT gates without changing functionality.

golden.reference: Done. Decomposed the XOR gates in the fanin cone of n2281 into AND/OR/NOT gates with functionality preserved: 1 XOR (g5500, inputs n83/n4898) matched and remapped.
golden.notes: Checker: response must clearly claim the decomposition was PERFORMED on the design (functionality preserved); output netlist should have no XOR left in the cone of n2281. Reliable evidence (Team3/Team4/Team7 only): full-score Team3 and Team4 both report exactly 1 XOR matched and remapped (Team3: +7 new gates), and Team7 independently identifies the same single XOR g5500 (inputs n83/n4898) in the cone, so the consensus is 1 XOR in the cone. The matched count is not hard-required (grading centers on the applied-transform claim plus the output netlist) but must be self-consistent with the team's own netlist. Team7 (4/5) only gave a textbook explanation of how g5500 COULD be decomposed (A xor B = (A and not B) or (not A and B)) without stating the transform was applied -- almost certainly Team7's lost point. Team2's exchanged log is a different run from its graded one and is not score-anchorable; its 'no matching XOR in cone' answer is noted only as evidence that cone extraction is tool-dependent, not as an accepted graded answer.
